answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 21274 Country: United States of America Title: I have a question about greeting elders. In our culture, the young bend down to greet their elders and the elders put their hand over the head and make a dua. I wanted to know if it is permissible Islamically to greet your father, grandfather, etc. by lowering the head? Question: AsSalamuAlaikum. I have a question about greeting elders. In our culture, the young bend down to greet their elders and the elders put their hand over the head and make a dua. I wanted to know if it is permissible Islamically to greet your father, grandfather, etc. by lowering the head? Answer ID: 21274 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 491/491/M=1431) The culture of greeting by bowing down is not right. It is forbidden in hadith to bow down while meeting with each other. It is mentioned in Mishkat al-Masabih that a person asked the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) whether one should bow down before his brother or friend when he meets him? The holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) replied: No. (Mishkat: p 401) One should not greet one?s father and grandfather as well by bowing down. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
